method_notes: FIXTURE FOR TESTS. Every business in this file is made up.

observations.issue: Hours conflict within its own site
observations.evidence: One page lists Tuesday as closed while the home page shows open every day.

qualified.strengths: A full text menu with prices and working online ordering.
qualified.suggested_improvement: One page the restaurant controls with one correct set of hours.
qualified.package_reason: The core need is one accurate page.
qualified.fit_reason: A specific inconsistency worth mentioning, but the fix is small.
qualified.personal_opening: I've worked in restaurants and now build simple websites for independent ones. While checking your hours I noticed that one page lists Tuesday as closed while the home page shows open every day. I wanted to mention it in case it is news to you, and I can show you exactly what I saw.
qualified.verify_before_outreach: Open the site on a phone and compare the hours on each page. Ask staff what the real Tuesday hours are.
